objectives: Identify the squ skill that needs support.
Practise the taught /s/ /k/ /w/ onset without inserting a vowel.
Decode and spell fresh squ-words with sound evidence.
Show improvement on fresh reassessment items before advancing.
concepts: Remediation responds to a specific observed error.
Fresh items test transfer beyond memorised examples.
Sound-to-letter mapping supports reading and spelling.

definitions.definition: Targeted instruction and practice for a skill that needs support.
A new check used to see whether learning improved.
Using a learned skill on a new item.

activities.name: Repair the squ error and try a fresh item
steps: Review the target skill and a worked example.
Complete a guided example and explain the sound or text evidence.
Reread or recheck and repair any mismatch.

activities.name: Find the error and repair a fresh item
steps: Review a sample response with one target-skill error.
Identify the sound, grapheme, or evidence that does not match.
Correct the response and explain why.
Complete a fresh item without the model or answer key.
